scope: Single CPU capture and descriptive cross-source replay comparison; not same-training-budget evaluation.

method.base_band: 7-9 Hz one-sided periodogram integrated RMS, SI meters; linear detrend, periodic Hann, PSD normalized by fs*sum(window**2), bin width fs/N.
method.peak_bin_amplitude: 2*abs(rFFT)/sum(Hann): coherent sine amplitude at a sampled frequency, not total band amplitude.
method.startup: Full recording retained; after_2s is a separate disclosed view, not removed from success criteria.
method.calculation_sanity_check: 4mm 8Hz sine plus linear drift reproduced RMS=4mm/sqrt(2) within1e-8m.
method.zero_power: A zero-power band has no reported peak frequency.

limitations: Our capture uses CPU, seed2027, fixed0.494922kg, smooth-v1 1000update policy; teammate captures use CUDA, seed11, different checkpoints and source hash.
Teammate metadata lacks raw joint/action arrays; only base-height bands can be compared.
Single-episode diagnostic; not formal 150episode protocol and not evidence of equal-budget superiority.
Band amplitude does not identify a causal mechanism; very small simulated variations may reflect numerical precision.
